about: Per-op byte vectors. `fns` says which interface each fn number is in the example; `state` is the probe state the answer assumes. Requests with session_id 0x11223344 come from the session that holds the lock; lock-free requests carry 0. `events` are notification frames (core §11.2) with the generation each carries; `data` are data frames, with `keep` the bytes from the frame's start the host keeps.
